recreation_brief:
1. Background: set the slide background to solid light gray #E8E8E8 (no gradient, no image).
2. Red frame: draw one rectangle with no fill and a solid red #C00000 outline (~2.5 pt), inset ~2-3% from all four slide edges (about 0.3 in on a 13.33x7.5 in slide); it must enclose every other element.
3. Slide-number badge: at top-right (~88-96% width, ~8-18% height, inside the frame) insert an oval ~0.5 x 0.35 in, fill pale yellow #FFFF99, outline purple #6633CC (~1.5 pt), containing the numeral '1' centered at ~12 pt in color #333333.
4. Title: one center-aligned text box spanning ~80% of slide width, top edge at ~25% height (the two-line block occupies ~25-45% height); line 1 'Linear Regression &', line 2 'Classification'; Arial Bold ~44 pt, red #C00000.
5. Subtitle: one centered text box at ~53-58% height containing the single line 'CSAI 253  -  Spring 2024' (preserve the double spaces around the hyphen); Arial Bold ~24 pt, dark blue #2222CC.
6. Prepared By block: one centered text box at ~63-77% height with three stacked center-aligned lines: 'Prepared By' (Times New Roman Italic ~20 pt, red #C00000); 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Times New Roman Bold Italic ~22 pt, blue #2222CC); 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial Bold ~14 pt, blue #2222CC).
7. Instructors block: one left-aligned text box at bottom-left (~8-40% width, ~77-98% height) with five stacked lines: 'Instructors:' (Arial Bold Italic ~18 pt, red #C00000); 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Arial Bold Italic ~16 pt, blue #2222CC); 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial ~14 pt, blue #2222CC); 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata' (Arial Bold Italic ~16 pt, blue #2222CC); 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial ~14 pt, blue #2222CC).
8. Logo part 1 (teal square): at bottom-right (~60-93% width, ~84-98% height) place a teal #339999 square containing, top to bottom: tiny white Arabic text 'مدينة زويل للعلوم والتكنولوجيا [?]' (transcription uncertain), a white abstract emblem of curved strokes (mountain/flask-like motif), bold white 'ZEWAIL CITY', and tiny white 'UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY'; if the official Zewail City logo image is available, insert it instead of hand-building this square.
9. Logo part 2 (white panel): immediately to the right of the teal square, place a white rectangle with bold maroon #A03030 Arabic 'جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا' on top and smaller dark-red #8B0000 'University of Science and Technology' beneath.
10. Exclusions: add no bullets, charts, or equations (title-only slide), and do NOT reproduce the white mouse-cursor arrow at ~85% width / ~72% height — it is a screen-recording artifact, not slide content.
